messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick ask 5 — can we make a 1-page 'Deploy Choice Pocket Guide' for enterprise buyers? needs to be ultra-scannable for the webinar pre-read.
Ethan (Product): yep. Goals: 3-line framing, 3-column mini-compare, 2 benchmark callouts (mark as 'example workload'), and a 1-line migration path.
Leah (Field): include KMS/HSM support, VPC peering, audit retention options, and a short FinServ example. one-liners for discovery are helpful.
Owen (Sales): simple routing rules so SDRs know who to hand off to. and a CTA for the launch post (15-min consult).
Maya (Marketing): proposed micro-layout:
- Header: 1-sentence problem + Risk vs Speed tag
- Core: Hosted | Dedicated | Private with rows: Security, SLA, Cost, Time-to-ship
- Side: 2 benchmark nuggets + 3 persona one-liners
- Footer: routing snippet + CTA
Ethan (Product): benchmark (example workload):
- Hosted: 95th-pctl ~110ms at 1k qps, 128-token avg (example workload)
- Dedicated: reserved GPUs -> ~35% lower unit cost at steady >1M tokens/day (example workload)
Note: runtime supports KV cache and model fallbacks.
Leah (Field): persona one-liners:
- Platform Lead: "Dedicated = predictable throughput + private networking."
- CISO: "Private + customer KMS + audit logs = compliance baseline."
- PM: "Hosted = fastest to iterate; streaming + tool calls ready."
Owen (Sales): routing pseudo-rules (ops-friendly):
```yaml
if needs_hsm or data_residency == true or compliance in ["HIPAA","PCI"]:
  route: AE+SE
elif projected_tokens_per_day >= 1_000_000 or expected_qps >= 800:
  route: AE (consider Dedicated)
else:
  route: SDR -> self-serve nurture
```
assets-bot: uploaded 1768882222-deploy-pocket-guide-v0.pdf to thread.
Maya (Marketing): copy constraints: keep main blurb <120 words, clean two-tone header, accessible PDF + 1-slide. keep benchmark claims conservative and labeled.
Ethan (Product): add migration path line: "Start Hosted -> move to Dedicated for scale -> Private for regulated, isolated needs."
Leah (Field): will paste FinServ scenario and drop discovery snippets by EOD.
Owen (Sales): CTA for post: "Not sure which deployment fits your risk profile? Book a 15-min infra consult: https://redwood.ai/book-demo". will prep AE talking points when copy locks.
Maya (Marketing): owners: Maya draft today; Ethan fact-check tomorrow AM; Leah field examples by noon; Owen routing to ops by afternoon; Design finalize 24h after draft. target: webinar pre-read Friday. :white_check_mark:
